parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State or imply the form $\frac{A}{3a+2x}+\frac{B}{2a-x}$ and use a correct method to find a constant. M1. Obtain one of $A=3$ and $B=-1$. A1; allow M1 A1 if a correct $A$ or $B$ is found even if there are unwanted terms in the partial-fractions expression. Obtain the second value. A1 ISW. Total: [3]

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use a correct method to obtain the first two terms in the expansion of $(3a+2x)^{-1}$, $\left(1+\frac{2x}{3a}\right)^{-1}$, $(2a-x)^{-1}$ or $\left(1-\frac{x}{2a}\right)^{-1}$. M1. Obtain the correct unsimplified expansions in terms of $a$ up to $x^2$. A2 FT; A1 FT for each partial fraction, following their $A,B$: $\frac3{3a}\left(1-\frac{2x}{3a}+\left(\frac{2x}{3a}\right)^2+\cdots\right)$ and $-\frac1{2a}\left(1+\frac{x}{2a}+\left(\frac{x}{2a}\right)^2+\cdots\right)$. Obtain $\frac1{2a}-\frac{11}{12a^2}x+\frac{23}{72a^3}x^2$. A1. Ignore higher powers; do not ISW; allow reverse order. Total: [4]
